Hi Sara / Jacob,

Thanks again for the call this morning 



 appreciate the time and the clear context on Elara's production timeline and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of requirements you shared:
- PHI handling for patient notes and prescriptions (ingested and stored)
- Need a signed BAA and evidence of SOC 2 Type II controls for hosting
- Audit log access for security and privacy teams; retention ~7 years
- Prefer Private VPC or Dedicated depending on whether we can meet your encryption + access controls requirements

Redwood deployment options we recommend considering:
1) Private VPC (customer-managed network): best for strict network isolation + customer KMS/HSM control - meets most on-prem/VPC requirements but involves more onboarding time
2) Dedicated capacity (Redwood-managed GPUs reserved for Elara): provides tenant isolation and predictable SLAs; Redwood manages infra but we can enforce encryption at rest + SOC 2 attestation
3) Hosted API (shared tenancy): fastest to get started, but only acceptable if PHI is de-identified or if Elara accepts our standard BAA + control set - usually not preferred for full PHI workloads

Immediate asks from Elara so we can recommend a firm path:
- Please confirm whether Elara requires customer-managed KMS/HSM (yes/no)
- Which audit/logging format or SIEM integration do you need (e.g., S3 exports, Splunk/Datadog webhook, syslog)?
- Target pilot start date (you mentioned early Jan)

I'll loop in our security & solutions engineers to share SOC2 artifacts and a sample network diagram. After we confirm KMS and logging, we can recommend Dedicated vs Private and share a BAA draft for your legal team.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa - that recap is perfect. A few clarifications from our security and infra teams: 

- KMS: We require customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest (AWS KMS CMKs). HSM optional but preferred for keys used to sign audit artifacts.
- Audit logs: We need real-time forwarding to our Splunk instance + daily S3 archival (encrypted). Retention: 7 years for audit records.
- SOC2: we need the full Type II report (not just a summary) and any supporting control matrices that show encryption, access controls, and change management.
- BAA: Please send a draft we can share with Legal. We will likely require a clause about data location (US-only) and subprocessor list.

Pilot: Jan 10 would be ideal if we can get the BAA and SOC2 evidence this week to start procurement.

Also looping in Jacob (Infra) - Jacob, can you confirm any additional network/VPC constraints?

Hi all - quick technical note from the infra/SE side: 

- Private VPC: supports customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own CMKs) and can be configured to route signing calls to a customer HSM via VPC endpoints. We typically model this as: customer KMS for data-at-rest + Redwood config to use the CMK for envelope encryption. HSM for signing requires network peering and may add ~2 weeks to onboarding for HSM cert exchange.

- Dedicated capacity: can be configured with customer-managed KMS for S3 and EBS volumes; however HSM-based signing is more complex because keys would be managed outside Redwood - doable but we recommend Private VPC if HSM is mandatory.

- Logging: we can stream audit logs to Splunk via HTTPS/S3; daily encrypted S3 archive is standard. Retention policy can be applied on the S3 bucket side.

I attached a sample network_arch_diagram.png that shows a Private VPC topology and where CMK/HSM integrations sit. Also attached is a BAA_Draft_Elara_Health.docx (redline-friendly) and a high-level SOC2 summary (we will follow up with the full Type II report via secure share).

Proposed immediate plan to hit Jan 10 pilot:
1) Legal: exchange BAA draft this week and flag subprocessor list
2) Security: Redwood (Neha) to provide full SOC2 Type II via secure link by EOD Wednesday
3) Infra: Elara to confirm CMK ownership and whether HSM signing is required by end of week
4) Tech sync: 30-min call Wed/Thu to confirm network and logging endpoints

Happy to run the tech sync - Marissa, I can do Wed 11/25 9am PT or Thu 11/26 10am PT.

- Dylan

Attachments: network_arch_diagram.png, BAA_Draft_Elara_Health.docx, SOC2_TypeII_2026_summary.pdf
